home.title: An advanced local image editor
home.description: Focale is a modern raster image editor for Linux, Windows and macOS: layers, masks, non-destructive adjustments, filters and layer effects, with support for Photoshop files. In development — leave your address to hear about the first alpha.

hero.badge: In development · alpha on the way
hero.title: An advanced image editor that runs
hero.subtitle: Layers, masks, non-destructive adjustments, filters and layer effects — and the Photoshop files you already own open straight away.

advanced.title: An advanced editor
advanced.description: Layers and groups, masks, blend modes, non-destructive adjustments, filters and a full layer-effects stack. Not a viewer with a brush bolted on.

crossPlatform.title: One editor, three systems
crossPlatform.description: The same codebase targets Linux, Windows and macOS, so a project moves between them untouched.

photoshop.title: At home with Photoshop
photoshop.description: Opens PSD documents, ABR brushes, PAT patterns and CSH custom shapes, so years of work and presets come with you.

preview.title: A modern editor with a clean, familiar interface.
preview.description: Focale keeps the layout every serious image editor shares — a menu bar, document tabs, a tool rail, layer and history panels — so there is nothing to relearn before the first edit.
preview.alt: The Focale editor with a photograph of an aurora open, showing the tool rail, the selection options bar and the layers panel.
preview.caption: Provisional screenshot from a development build. The interface is still changing.

notes.menus: A real menu bar and keyboard shortcuts, where you expect them.
notes.panels: Layers, channels, paths, history and swatches, in dockable panels.
notes.canvas: A canvas that zooms on the pointer and pans with the trackpad.

features.title: Everything a serious editing session needs.
features.description: The pieces below are what Focale is built out of — most of them already running in the development build.
features.note: Almost everything listed here works today; the rest lands with the alpha. That release is about stability and packaging, not about finishing this list.

localFirst.title: Local-first by design
localFirst.description: Documents live on your disk. Focale opens, edits and saves them locally, and never sends your work anywhere.

layers.title: Layers and groups
layers.description: Raster layers, nested groups and text layers, with drag-to-reorder, opacity, blend modes, locking and live thumbnails.

nonDestructive.title: Non-destructive adjustments
nonDestructive.description: Colour adjustments sit on a layer as re-editable, reorderable properties that never touch the source pixels — and can still be burnt in when you want them permanent.

filters.title: Filters and a filter gallery
filters.description: Blur, distortion, noise, pixelation, render, sharpen and stylize families. Each previews at true scale and undoes as a single edit.

layerEffects.title: Layer effects
layerEffects.description: Bevel and emboss, stroke, inner and outer shadows and glows, satin, colour, gradient and pattern overlays — derived from the layer's alpha and composited at paint time, so they stay exact at any zoom.

tools.title: A full tool rail
tools.description: Brush, pencil and eraser, clone stamp, blur, sharpen, smudge, dodge, burn and sponge, paint bucket, gradient, text, eyedropper and selection tools, sharing one engine and one set of controls.

masks.title: Layer masks
masks.description: Add a mask from the current selection, then paint, fill or gradient it to reveal exactly as much as you want.

formats.title: Open, edit, export
formats.description: PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, JPEG XL, TIFF, BMP and PSD, in and out, with resizing, aspect-ratio locking and quality control — plus .focale projects for everything in between. The wider format list arrives with the alpha.

recovery.title: Autosave and crash recovery
recovery.description: Snapshots live beside the application, never on top of your file, and a recovered document opens unsaved so nothing on disk can be overwritten by accident.

roadmap.title: Four steps to the first alpha.
roadmap.description: Focale is built in the open, so here is an honest picture rather than a release date.

foundations.title: Solid foundations
foundations.description: The project's groundwork and a simple image editor that opens, edits and saves without falling over.

features.title: Building the feature set
features.description: Layers, tools, selections, adjustments, filters and layer effects — the work happening right now.

debugging.title: Debugging
debugging.description: Hunting down what the feature work left behind, widening test coverage and exercising all three systems.
